;; Pinned GNU on an 80x24 terminal frame, by format-mode-line-tty.py; do not edit.
(progn (switch-to-buffer (get-buffer-create "fml")) (insert "line one\nline two\n") (goto-char 5) (defvar fml-on nil) (defvar fml-name "lit%b") (setq mode-name "Fml"))
(format-mode-line "%b")
#("fml" 0 3 (mode-line-elt-no 1))
(format-mode-line "%b %l:%c %C")
#("fml 1:4 5" 0 3 (mode-line-elt-no 1) 3 4 (mode-line-elt-no 1) 4 5 (mode-line-elt-no 1) 5 6 (mode-line-elt-no 1) 6 7 (mode-line-elt-no 1) 7 8 (mode-line-elt-no 1) 8 9 (mode-line-elt-no 1))
(format-mode-line '("" "a" (:propertize "b" face bold) "c"))
#("abc" 0 1 (mode-line-elt-no 3) 1 2 (face bold mode-line-elt-no 5) 2 3 (mode-line-elt-no 6))
(format-mode-line '("" "a" (:propertize "b" face bold) "c") 'italic)
#("abc" 0 1 (mode-line-elt-no 3 face italic) 1 2 (face (bold italic) mode-line-elt-no 5) 2 3 (mode-line-elt-no 6 face italic))
(format-mode-line '(:propertize "%b" face bold) t)
#("fml" 0 3 (face (bold mode-line-active) mode-line-elt-no 2))
(format-mode-line '(:propertize "%b" face bold) 1)
"fml"
(format-mode-line '("" "x" (:propertize "y" face bold)) 'default)
#("xy" 0 1 (mode-line-elt-no 3) 1 2 (face bold mode-line-elt-no 5))
(format-mode-line "%5b|")
#("fml  |" 0 3 (mode-line-elt-no 1) 3 5 (mode-line-elt-no 1) 5 6 (mode-line-elt-no 1))
(format-mode-line '(-2 "abcdef"))
#("ab" 0 2 (mode-line-elt-no 3))
(format-mode-line '(8 "ab") 'bold)
#("ab      " 0 2 (mode-line-elt-no 3 face bold) 2 8 (face bold))
(format-mode-line '("" (6 "ab") "|"))
#("ab    |" 0 2 (mode-line-elt-no 5) 6 7 (mode-line-elt-no 6))
(format-mode-line "%-")
#("--" 0 2 (mode-line-elt-no 1))
(format-mode-line "<%3->")
#("<-- >" 0 1 (mode-line-elt-no 1) 1 3 (mode-line-elt-no 1) 3 4 (mode-line-elt-no 1) 4 5 (mode-line-elt-no 1))
(format-mode-line '(:eval (concat "x" "y")))
#("xy" 0 2 (mode-line-elt-no 2))
(format-mode-line '(fml-on "yes" "no"))
#("no" 0 2 (mode-line-elt-no 2))
(format-mode-line '("" fml-name))
#("lit%b" 0 5 (mode-line-elt-no 4))
(format-mode-line "a\tb")
#("a	b" 0 3 (mode-line-elt-no 1))
(format-mode-line "%*%+%&")
#("***" 0 1 (mode-line-elt-no 1) 1 2 (mode-line-elt-no 1) 2 3 (mode-line-elt-no 1))
(format-mode-line "é%b")
#("éfml" 0 1 (mode-line-elt-no 1) 1 4 (mode-line-elt-no 1))
(format-mode-line '("" mode-name))
#("Fml" 0 3 (mode-line-elt-no 4))
(format-mode-line '("" "%b" (:eval (format-mode-line "-%l-"))))
#("fml-1-" 0 3 (mode-line-elt-no 3) 3 4 (mode-line-elt-no 2) 4 5 (mode-line-elt-no 2) 5 6 (mode-line-elt-no 2))
(format-mode-line "%p %P %q %i %n")
#("All All All    18 " 0 3 (mode-line-elt-no 1) 3 4 (mode-line-elt-no 1) 4 7 (mode-line-elt-no 1) 7 8 (mode-line-elt-no 1) 8 14 (mode-line-elt-no 1) 14 15 (mode-line-elt-no 1) 15 17 (mode-line-elt-no 1) 17 18 (mode-line-elt-no 1))
(format-mode-line '("" "%b") nil nil (get-buffer "*scratch*"))
#("*scratch*" 0 9 (mode-line-elt-no 3))
(format-mode-line "%%%m")
#("%Fml" 0 1 (mode-line-elt-no 1) 1 4 (mode-line-elt-no 1))
